Oneliner

On-board AI platform with image processing capability.
Description

Adopts the "one-star dual-core" system structure, equipped with the second-generation on-board AI platform designed and developed by our team. The image processing capability is more than 1000 times that of the same weight satellite. It is the first high-performance satellite independently developed by Guoxing Aerospace. It is arguably one of the most 'smart' commercial satellites in the world.
Notes

Initially thought they were made by ADA Space and were perhaps developed together, but marking Spacety as manufacturer, because fits very well fit with their TY numbering.
